concept: Feeling proud of something you made yourself, even if it's not perfect
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character makes something imperfect but is proud of it because they made it themselves and tried hard
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why was the character proud even though it wasn't perfect?
exercise.practice: Student shares something they made and one thing they're proud of about it

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific thing they're proud of, distinct from just 'it's good'
